text.en: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : Consume the magazine and load a round with additional range and damage.

Hold [Reload] to consume up to 4 ammo. Gain one stack of 'Honed Edge' per ammo consumed to create a single shot with increased damage.

Damage increase based on stacks of Honed Edge:
Honed Edge x2:
• <pve 12% /> <pvp [20%] /> bodyshot damage
• <pve 79% /> <pvp [91%] /> critical damage
Honed Edge x3:
• <pve 25% /> <pvp [45%] /> bodyshot damage
• <pve 131% /> <pvp [167%] /> critical damage
Honed Edge x4:
• <pve 112% /> <pvp [165%] /> bodyshot damage
• <pve 291% /> <pvp [389%] /> critical damage

/*
If you got any better ideas to divide 2 categories (PvE/PvP) and 2 locations (bodyshot/headshot) across three stacks, you let me know. I think this ended up pretty good all things considered.

Damage increase at 2|3|4 Stacks of Honed Edge:

• x2: <pve 12% /> <pvp [20%] /> Bodyshot Damage | <pve 79% /> <pvp [91%] /> Critical Damage
• x3: <pve 25% /> <pvp [45%] /> Bodyshot Damage | <pve 131% /> <pvp [167%] /> Critical Damage
• x4: <pve 112% /> <pvp [165%] /> Bodyshot Damage | <pve 291% /> <pvp [389%] /> Critical Damage
*/
